description: This file defines the BookmarkManager class responsible for managing bookmark data within the app, including adding, removing, and retrieving bookmarks stored in shared preferences.

classes.name: BookmarkManager
classes.description: A class that manages user bookmarks by storing and retrieving them from shared preferences.

methods.name: getBookmarks
methods.description: Returns the set of bookmarked book IDs.

methods.name: isBookBookmarked
methods.description: Checks if a specific book ID is bookmarked.

methods.name: addBookmark
methods.description: Adds a new bookmark for a specified book ID.

methods.name: removeBookmark
methods.description: Removes a bookmark for a specified book ID.
